name: space_game
description: **Dynamic Asteroid Fields:** Generate space rocks of various sizes moving in random directions. The player loses points or time upon collision. **Floating Space Debris:** Static or rotating obstacles, such as satellite wreckage or abandoned spaceships, requiring sharp maneuvers to avoid.  **Time Extension Crystals:** Glowing green crystalline objects that grant the player +5 additional seconds when collected, saving them before the timer expires.
